items.name: XCyte 1 (Human mBAND Probe)
items.note: The mBAND technique is based on a series of partial chromosome paints for sequential partially overlapping chromosome regions  of a single chromosome. For labeling the same 5 fluorochromes as in the 24XCyte probe are used. The characteristic multicolor banding pattern of mBAND is generated by quantifying the fluorescence intensity ratios along the chromosome. These ratios are unique and visualized
